doc.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023

title: Large-bore trumpet and mouthpiece for ballads
summary: He shows a larger horn and deeper mouthpiece he uses for ballads and plays its warmer sound.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Let me use another tool that I got here, because I got different ones you know, I’ve got different ones with different — hold on one second. Yes, I’ve got another horn here which is a lot larger. The bell, the bore, they’re very big, extra large, and an extra large mouthpiece as well you know. It’s a kind of inside it’s a kind of a French horn mouthpiece. The rim is a copy of my normal Bach 1-1/4 mouthpiece trumpet. But inside it’s completely different you know, it’s a big hole, very deep, and you can see, you see it? Let me show you a normal trumpet mouthpiece.
It’s a huge difference. And this is what I use if I’m going to record a ballad or something. And you will notice the difference in the sound.
It’s a little warmer sound, you know, and it’s a little air within the sound, which is made a little more human.
